heading: The paperwork is where good jobs go sideways
subhead: None of this is about your workshop's skill. It's about how much gets re-typed between the design and the door.

quote.title: The same quote, rebuilt three times
quote.body: Every enquiry starts a fresh spreadsheet, even when it's close to a job you already priced last month.

measurements.title: Measurements re-keyed by hand
measurements.body: Dimensions get retyped from the design into the quote, then again into the work order — and every retype is a chance to get it wrong.

specs.title: Specs that don't match what got cut
specs.body: By the time a job reaches the workshop, the paper spec and the actual design have quietly drifted apart.

tracking.title: Work orders lost in chat threads
tracking.body: There's no single place to see what stage a job is at — just a scroll through WhatsApp trying to remember.
